subtitle: כתאב אלאמאנאת ואלאעתקאדאת — The Book of Beliefs and Opinions
author: Saadia Gaon (882–942)

aligned.ja: עלי אלחקיקה. ת'ם נרומהם אן יצרחוא באנה ג'סם, פאד'א אמתנעוא מן ד'לך וקאלוא לא יג'וז אן נקול אנה ג'סם אד' כל ג'סם מצנוע,
aligned.en: ...in truth. We then challenge them to openly declare that He is a body; and when they refuse and say it is impermissible to call Him a body, since every body is created,

pairs.en: we challenge them to openly declare that He is a body
they refuse

pairs.ja: לא יג'וז אן נקול אנה ג'סם אד' כל ג'סם מצנוע
pairs.en: it is impermissible to call Him a body since every body is created

aligned.ja: פכד'לך ילזמהם אלא יקולוא חיותה ועלמה גירה, אד' כל מן חיותה ועלמה גירה מצנוע.
aligned.en: we say: then by the same logic they must not say that His Life and His Knowledge are other than Him — for everything whose Life and Knowledge are other than it is likewise created.

pairs.ja: ילזמהם אלא יקולוא חיותה ועלמה גירה
pairs.en: they must not say His Life and Knowledge are other than Him

pairs.ja: כל מן חיותה ועלמה גירה מצנוע
pairs.en: everything whose Life and Knowledge are other than it is created

aligned.ja: והאולא ירחמך אללה ג'הלוא וג'ה אלאסתדלאל, וד'לך אנא מעאשר אלמוחדין אנמא אעתקדנא אן חיוה אלאנסאן גירה למא ראינאה וקתא חיא ווקתא מיתא,
aligned.en: These people — may God have mercy on you — misunderstood the direction of the argument: we, the community of the believers in unity, only believed that human life is other than the person because we see him alive at one time and dead at another;

pairs.en: they misunderstood the direction of the argument
the community of the believers in unity
we see him alive at one time and dead at another

aligned.ja: עלמנא אן שיא כאן פיה בה מא כאן חיא, פלמא זאל ענה צאר מיתא.
aligned.en: and so we knew that there was something in him by which he was alive, and when it departed he became dead.

pairs.ja: שיא כאן פיה בה מא כאן חיא
pairs.en: there was something in him by which he was alive
when it departed he became dead

aligned.ja: וכד'לך אנמא אעתקדנא אן עלם אלאנסאן גירה למא ראינאה וקתא יעלם ווקתא יג'הל עלמנא אן שיא מא כאן פיה בה כאן עאלמא, פלמא זאל ענה ג'הל,
aligned.en: Likewise we only believed that human knowledge is other than the person because we see him at one time knowing and at another time ignorant — and so we knew that there was something in him by which he was knowing, and when it departed he became ignorant;

pairs.en: we see him at one time knowing and at another time ignorant

pairs.ja: שיא מא כאן פיה בה כאן עאלמא
pairs.en: there was something in him by which he was knowing
when it departed he became ignorant

aligned.ja: ולולא מא שאהדנאה מן הד'ין אלאמרין פי אלאנסאן לאעתקדנא אן אלאנסאן חי עאלם לד'אתה.
aligned.en: and had we not observed these two conditions in the human being, we would have believed that the human is living and knowing by virtue of his essence itself.

pairs.ja: לולא מא שאהדנאה מן הד'ין אלאמרין
pairs.en: had we not observed these two conditions

pairs.ja: לאעתקדנא אן אלאנסאן חי עאלם לד'אתה
pairs.en: we would have believed the human is living and knowing by virtue of his essence

aligned.ja: פלמא אסתחאל באלחקיקה אן יוג'ד לכ'אלק אלכל וקת לא יכון פיה חיא ולא עאלמא כמא וג'ד ללאנסאן וג'ב לא מחאלה אן יכון חיא לעינה ועאלמא לעינה,
aligned.en: Since it is truly impossible that there should be a time when the Creator of all is not alive or not knowing — as does occur with the human — it follows necessarily that He is living in virtue of His very essence and knowing in virtue of His very essence;

pairs.ja: אסתחאל אן יוג'ד לכ'אלק אלכל וקת לא יכון פיה חיא ולא עאלמא
pairs.en: it is impossible that there should be a time when the Creator of all is not alive or not knowing

pairs.ja: וג'ב לא מחאלה אן יכון חיא לעינה ועאלמא לעינה
pairs.en: it follows necessarily that He is living and knowing in virtue of His very essence

aligned.ja: ובטל מא ד'הב אליה האולא אלקום מן אלאצל.
aligned.en: and the foundational premise these people adopted is thereby demolished.

pairs.ja: ובטל מא ד'הב אליה האולא אלקום מן אלאצל
pairs.en: the foundational premise these people adopted is thereby demolished

aligned.ja: ומע ד'לך פלם יופוא מעלומהם חקה עלי מד'הבהם, וד'לך אנהם קאלוא ד'אתה וחיותה ועלמה, ותרכוא אן יקולוא קדרתה,
aligned.en: Moreover, they did not do justice to their own doctrine, for they spoke of His essence, His life, and His knowledge, but omitted to mention His power;

pairs.ja: לם יופוא מעלומהם חקה עלי מד'הבהם
pairs.en: they did not do justice to their own doctrine
they spoke of His essence, His life, and His knowledge
but omitted to mention His power

aligned.ja: וכד'לך מעני סמיע ובציר, פאן כאן קולהם חי יגניהם ען קאדר, וקולהם עאלם יגניהם ען סמיע ובציר,
aligned.en: and likewise the meanings of 'Hearing' and 'Seeing' — for if their saying 'Living' makes 'Omnipotent' superfluous, and their saying 'Knowing' makes 'Hearing and Seeing' superfluous,

pairs.en: their saying 'Living' makes 'Omnipotent' superfluous

pairs.ja: קולהם עאלם יגניהם ען סמיע ובציר
pairs.en: their saying 'Knowing' makes 'Hearing and Seeing' superfluous

aligned.ja: פקולהם עאלם איצ'א יגניהם ען קולהם חי, אד' לא עאלם אלא חי, אלא תרי אנהם עלי מד'הבהם לם יסירוא, וחתי נט'רהם לם יתבעוא, ואנמא מוהוא בהד'א אלקול ליקימוא בה מא קיל להם.
aligned.en: then their saying 'Knowing' also makes 'Living' superfluous, since there is no Knowing except what is Living — you see then that they did not follow their own doctrine nor even pursue their own argument to its end, but fabricated this formula merely to ward off what was said against them.

pairs.ja: קולהם עאלם איצ'א יגניהם ען קולהם חי
pairs.en: their saying 'Knowing' makes 'Living' superfluous too
there is no Knowing except what is Living

pairs.ja: מוהוא בהד'א אלקול ליקימוא בה מא קיל להם
pairs.en: they fabricated this formula merely to ward off what was said against them

aligned.ja: ת'ם אקול לו ג'אזת פי מענאה תגיירה ואחדה לג'אז פיה כל תגייר פי אלדניא, לאן אלנט'ר אנמא ינט'ר
aligned.en: Then I say: if one change of meaning were permissible in Him, every change in the world would be permissible in Him — for rational inquiry examines only

pairs.ja: לו ג'אזת פי מענאה תגיירה ואחדה
pairs.en: if one change of meaning were permissible in Him

pairs.ja: לג'אז פיה כל תגייר פי אלדניא
pairs.en: every change in the world would be permissible in Him
for rational inquiry examines only

aligned.ja: פי ג'מל אלאשיא ואג'נאסהא, ליס ינט'ר פי אשכ'אצהא ופראדהא.
aligned.en: ...the totality of things and their classes, not their particular individuals.

pairs.en: the totality of things and their classes
not their particular individuals

aligned.ja: פאן כאן האולא אלקום ד'הבוא אלי אלאסתדלאל באלמעקול פקד בינא פסאדה עליהם פי מא אומאוא אליה,
aligned.en: If these people have pursued rational inference, we have already demonstrated its falsity with respect to what they pointed to;

pairs.en: they pursued rational inference

pairs.ja: בינא פסאדה עליהם פי מא אומאוא אליה
pairs.en: we have demonstrated its falsity with respect to what they pointed to

aligned.ja: ואן כאנוא אסתדלוא מן אלמכתוב כמא לעל בעצ'הם יקול ראית אלכתאב יקול אן ללה רוחא וכלמה ד'אך קולה רוח ה' דבר בי ומלתו על לשוני,
aligned.en: and if they have derived their argument from scripture — as perhaps some of them say: 'I have seen scripture state that God has Spirit and Word, as in: The spirit of the Lord speaks through me and His word is upon my tongue' (2 Sam. 23:2) —

pairs.en: they derived their argument from scripture
that God has Spirit and Word

pairs.ja: רוח ה' דבר בי ומלתו על לשוני
pairs.en: The spirit of the Lord speaks through me and His word is upon my tongue

aligned.ja: קלנא לה אן הד'ה אלרוח ואלכלמה מכ'לוקתאן, והמא ד'לך אלכלאם אלמפצ'ל אלד'י אוחי אללה בה אלי נביה,
aligned.en: we say to him: that Spirit and Word are created things — namely, the detailed speech that God revealed by prophecy to His prophet;

pairs.en: that Spirit and Word are created things

pairs.ja: אלכלאם אלמפצ'ל אלד'י אוחי אללה בה אלי נביה
pairs.en: the detailed speech God revealed by prophecy to His prophet

aligned.ja: וקד עלמנא אן אלכתב תסמי אסם אללה נפש כמא קאל אשר לא נשא לשוא נפשי מקאם שמי.
aligned.en: We also know that scripture uses 'soul' (nefesh) as a name for God, as in: 'He who has not lifted My soul — i.e., My name — to vanity' (Ps. 24:4).

pairs.en: scripture uses 'soul' as a name for God

pairs.ja: אשר לא נשא לשוא נפשי מקאם שמי
pairs.en: He who has not lifted My soul — My name — to vanity

aligned.ja: פכמא כאן פי אלמכ'לוקין נפש ורוח מעני ואחדא, וכאנת נפש ללכ'אלק מענאהא אסם, כאנת לה רוח מענאהא וחי ונבוה,
aligned.en: So just as in creatures 'soul' and 'spirit' have one meaning, while 'soul' applied to the Creator means His name — so 'spirit' applied to Him means His life and His prophecy;

pairs.ja: פי אלמכ'לוקין נפש ורוח מעני ואחדא
pairs.en: in creatures 'soul' and 'spirit' have one meaning
'soul' applied to the Creator means His name
'spirit' applied to Him means His life and His prophecy

aligned.ja: והד'א מן האולא אלמסתדלין קלהֵ בצר בלגהֵ אלעבראניון.
aligned.en: and this shows a shallow understanding of the Hebrew language on the part of these scriptural reasoners.

pairs.en: a shallow understanding
of the Hebrew language

aligned.ja: וכד'לך וג'דת בעצ'הם יסתדלון באן אלכתב קאלת אן רוח אללה תצנע בקולהא רוח אל עשתני ונשמת שדי תחיני,
aligned.en: Likewise I found some of them arguing that scripture says God's spirit creates, citing: 'The spirit of God made me and the breath of the Almighty gives me life' (Job 33:4);

pairs.ja: יסתדלון באן אלכתב קאלת אן רוח אללה תצנע
pairs.en: arguing that scripture says God's spirit creates

pairs.ja: רוח אל עשתני ונשמת שדי תחיני
pairs.en: The spirit of God made me and the breath of the Almighty gives me life

aligned.ja: וקאלת אן כלמתה תצנע בקולהא בדבר ה' שמים נעשו וברוח פיו, פראית הד'א איצ'א מן קלהֵ בצרהם באללגה,
aligned.en: and that His word creates, citing: 'By the word of the Lord the heavens were made and by the breath of His mouth' (Ps. 33:6) — and I regard this too as showing a shallow understanding of the language;

pairs.en: His word creates

pairs.ja: בדבר ה' שמים נעשו וברוח פיו
pairs.en: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made and by the breath of His mouth
showing a shallow understanding of the language

aligned.ja: ואנמא תריד אלכתב בקולהא אן אלצאנע צנע אלאשיא בקולה באמרה או במראדה או במשיתה, אנה צנעהא קצדא מנה, לא עלי טריק אלעבת' ולא אלגפלה ולא אלצ'רורה,
aligned.en: for what scripture means when it says the Maker made things 'by His word' — by His command, His will, His purpose — is that He made them intentionally, not through futility, negligence, or necessity;

pairs.en: the Maker made things by His word
by His command, His will, His purpose

pairs.ja: אנה צנעהא קצדא מנה לא עלי טריק אלעבת' ולא אלגפלה ולא אלצ'רורה
pairs.en: He made them intentionally, not through futility, negligence, or necessity

aligned.ja: עלי מא תקול והוא באחד ומי ישיבנו ונפשו אותה ויעש, ותריד בקולהא אנה צנעהא בכלמתה וברוח פיו ובקולה
aligned.en: as in: 'He is in one, and who can turn Him? And His soul desires, and He does' (Job 23:13) — and the meaning of 'He made them by His word, by the breath of His mouth, by His speech'

pairs.ja: והוא באחד ומי ישיבנו ונפשו אותה ויעש
pairs.en: He is in one, who can turn Him? His soul desires and He does

pairs.ja: תריד בקולהא אנה צנעהא בכלמתה וברוח פיו ובקולה
pairs.en: the meaning of 'He made them by His word, by the breath of His mouth, by His speech'

aligned.ja: ובדעותה אנה צנעהא דפעה לא פי מדה ולא ג'ז ג'ז עלי מא יקול קורא אני אליהם יעמדו יחדו.
aligned.en: ...and by His knowledge — is that He made them all at once, not over time and not piece by piece, as in: 'Stand and let them stand together' (Is. 48:13).

pairs.ja: צנעהא דפעה לא פי מדה ולא ג'ז ג'ז
pairs.en: He made them all at once, not over time and not piece by piece
let them stand together

aligned.ja: ותמת'ל לנא ד'לך באלשי אלד'י נקול לה תעאל או ננפך' עליה ברוח פינא, כד'אך וברוח פיו כל צבאם, מנשמת רוח אפך.
aligned.en: Scripture illustrates this for us by analogy to a thing we say 'come' to, or breathe upon with our own breath — in the same way: 'by the breath of His mouth all their host' (Ps. 33:6), 'by the blast of the breath of Your nostrils' (Ex. 15:8).

pairs.en: a thing we say 'come' to
or breathe upon with our own breath
by the breath of His mouth all their host

aligned.ja: ומע ד'לך פאג'דהם תארכין למד'הבהם, לאן אלכתב תקול אן ידה תצנע כי יד ה' עשתה זאת, ואן עינה תחפט' עיני ה' נצרו דעת,
aligned.en: Despite all this I find them abandoning their own position — for scripture says His hand creates: 'For the hand of the Lord has done this' (Is. 41:20), and His eye watches: 'The eyes of the Lord guard knowledge' (Prov. 22:12);

pairs.en: abandoning their own position

pairs.ja: ידה תצנע — כי יד ה' עשתה זאת
pairs.en: His hand creates: For the hand of the Lord has done this

pairs.ja: עינה תחפט' — עיני ה' נצרו דעת
pairs.en: His eye watches: The eyes of the Lord guard knowledge

aligned.en: and His vineyard gathers: 'The glory of the Lord will gather you' (Is. 58:8), and His anger rises: 'The anger of God rose against them' (Ps. 78:31), and His mercy receives: 'Let Your mercies come to me and I will live' (Ps. 119:77) —

pairs.en: His vineyard gathers: The glory of the Lord will gather you

pairs.en: His anger rises: The anger of God rose against them

aligned.ja: פיכון כל ואחד מן הד'ה אלמעאני ומא יוג'ד מת'להא לה כ'ואץ אכ'ר מזאדה עלי אלרוח ואלכלמה, אד' להד'ה כלהא פעל מנסוב כמא לתלך פעל מנסוב.
aligned.en: so each of these meanings, and all analogous ones, would constitute additional distinct hypostases beyond Spirit and Word, since all of these have actions attributed to them just as Spirit and Word do.

pairs.ja: כל ואחד מן הד'ה אלמעאני לה כ'ואץ אכ'ר מזאדה עלי אלרוח ואלכלמה

pairs.ja: להד'ה כלהא פעל מנסוב כמא לתלך פעל מנסוב
pairs.en: all of these have actions attributed to them just as Spirit and Word do

aligned.ja: והד'ה ארשדך אללה ואמת'אלהא מג'אזאת ענדנא פי אללפט' ואתסאעאת אתסעת בהא אללגה, ולכל ואחד מנהא תקריב ותפהים, שרחה פי מא יסתאנף בעון אלרחמן.
aligned.en: All these — may God guide you — and their like are, for us, figures of speech and expansive usages by which language extends itself; each of them has its own approximation and explanation, which I will treat in what follows, with the aid of the Merciful.

pairs.en: figures of speech for us
expansive usages by which language extends itself
each has its own approximation and explanation

aligned.en: Section 6. I have found some of them interpreting 'The Lord created me at the beginning of His way' (Prov. 8:22) to mean that God has an eternal Word that never ceased to exist alongside Him and that creates;

pairs.en: Section 6
The Lord created me at the beginning of His way

pairs.ja: אן ללה כלמה קדימה לם תזל מעה תכ'לק
